name: Night Drive
source:
You wake up in the backseat of a moving car with bounded wrists and ankles. Through the rear-view mirror, you see the face of the driver.

You have no idea who he is.

[From [url=https://hangingbrain.itch.io/night-drive]itch.io[/url]]
